text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text:
Sofia, the lamp delivery at door 6 was on **Pellow**, not Pellucid.

Your February exchange in #coastal-team (Feb 17) settles it: the retail account showing the door 6 lamp delivery is Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark Retail, and "PHL" in the morning report was ambiguous because Pellucid Harbor Logistics also uses that code. Pellucid is the Gulf Coast terminal account, and the container pickup was theirs.

Pellow's account profile is also still useful: it has an old CLR code and a new PHL code, and the Pemberline Dock export may still show the old name. The profile notes that the export issue was raised in February.
